headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that that 69% of respondents oppose the construction of AI data centers in their local area, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: Jamie Raskin says impeaching Trump again ‘not a taboo with us’ but ‘not a panacea’
headlines.description: Rep. Jamie Raskin (D-Md.) tells Meet the Press that President Trump has “undoubtedly” committed impeachable acts in his second term and a third impeachment could be a “critical tool in the toolbox” for Democrats if they retake control of the House.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. John Kennedy says the U.S. must ‘choke [Putin] to death’ as Trump admin meets with him
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.) tells Meet the Press Congress “missed a big chance” on passing Russia sanctions as Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff meet with Vladimir Putin in Russia.

headlines.title: Millions under severe weather threat over Labor Day weekend
headlines.description: Nearly 10 million people are facing severe weather threats over the holiday weekend, including torrential downpours, powerful winds and huge hail. In the Detroit area, tens of thousands are without power after storms there. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Andrew Williams, Every Time I Die guitarist known to wrestling fans as ‘The Butcher,’ dies
headlines.description: Andrew Williams, the longtime rhythm guitarist for metalcore band Every Time I Die, who went by “The Butcher” in his other career as a professional wrestler, has died, All Elite Wrestling has confirmed.
